thread:
elena: Quick sync — ACME wants a narrow install window for their on‑prem private deploy next week. NetOps constraint: no outbound to third‑party IPs during cutover. Need confirmation on installer options, rollback path, and SLA implications.
noah: I can take NetOps constraints. Clarify: are we doing a full airgap install or staged with temporary egress for images/presigns?
matt: Customer prefers airgap but can allow pulls via presigned URLs within a 2‑hour maintenance window. That matches their compliance ask.
sarah: 2h is tight if DB migrations run. We need a hard max downtime and a fast rollback. Can we do a canary on 10% of tenants first to validate?
elena: Canary required. Field asked for a "zero config" rollback if things go sideways. Proposal: staged canary -> bulk -> rollback to snapshot. Can someone draft rollback steps for the runbook?
kevin: I updated a runbook fragment in #runbooks earlier. Quick installer flags we plan to use:
```sh
redwood-installer --airgap --presigned-bucket="s3://acme-presigns" --ip-whitelist=10.0.0.0/16
```
Will that align with their IPAM policy/no-external-egress?
noah: IP ranges look fine but NetOps needs to map customer NAT & preserve ports. Also need to call out DNS handoff timing — if they change internal FQDNs, tombstones could take ~30m.
matt: For SLA: Ops asked for a fallback to hosted runtime for critical routes during the upgrade. Customer won't allow cross‑tenant exfil though. Alternative: local fallback on spare nodes + traffic siphon — feasible?
sarah: Let's make launch criteria explicit:
  1) Runbook dry‑run completed in staging with field NetOps
  2) Canary success metrics: p99 latency <= baseline + 50ms, errors < 1%
  3) DB migration reversible and snapshot available
  4) NetOps signoff on IP/NAT/DNS plan
elena: :thumbsup: I'll collate those. Also propose a rollback cutoff — 45 minutes into the window if errors or latency spike above thresholds. Agree/disagree?
kevin: 45m seems reasonable. We'll also lock versions — field requested minor‑only upgrades for now. Pin runtime + model to exact hash; allow only config patches during window.
matt: I'll prepare a minimal field checklist to attach to the ticket: preflight IP check, presigned URL test, snapshot, canary traffic routing, monitoring hooks. Will post by EOD.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: private-deploy-cutover-acme — 2026-03-29 02:00 UTC. Invite: https://calendar/redwood/abcdef
noah: One more: update our customer‑managed routing doc with an appendix for NAT mappings & egress exceptions. I'll add it and ping field.
sarah: Also request a staged dry‑run with their NetOps in staging at least 48h before cutover to catch routing/NAT edge cases.
elena: Thanks all — I'll move this into the launch ticket and tag @oncall for the cutover day. Adding runbook owners and timeline now.
